name: delete_composite_key
comment: The by-key DELETE of a composite natural key (UserRole): every key part ANDed.

expect.sqlite: delete from user_roles where user_id = @user_id and role_id = @role_id
expect.sqlserver: set nocount on; delete from [user_roles] where [user_id] = @user_id and [role_id] = @role_id; select @@rowcount; set nocount off
